data.narrative:
Hidden Level is a Series C-stage defense and security company founded by Jeff Cole and Gary Dominicos that has raised $130M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 13 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Saronic, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C progression, yielding $221M. The peer-median approach benchmarks against the 13-company cohort, which spans a $300M-to-$18.0B range with a median valuation of $2.1B. Notable peers include Quantum-Systems ($8.0B, Series C), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D), anchoring the upper end of the distribution.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $188M (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in the defense-tech peer set, particularly stage skew and the outsize valuations of Series D leaders. The gap between stage-progression ($221M) and peer-median ($2.1B) hinges on whether Hidden Level's product maturity and market position are closer to earlier-stage or later-stage cohort members. Key uncertainties include revenue scale relative to comparables and specificity of the defense application within the broader sector.
